title: Quantitative mRNA Imaging in Whole Mount Drosophila Brains
protocol: Dissect 3-5 days old flies in ice-cold Schneider’s Insect Medium.
Fix dissected tissues in 2% PFA at 25°C for 55 min.
Wash fixed tissues with 0.5% PBT, 3 times, each for 10 min.
Dehydrate fixed tissues with 30%, 50%, 70%, and three rounds of 100% EtOH, each for 10 min.
Store dehydrated tissues at 4°C in 100% EtOH overnight on a rocker.
Rehydrate dehydrated tissues with 70%, 50%, and 30% EtOH, each for 10 min.
Incubate rehydrated tissues in 5% acetic acid at 4°C for 5 min.
Wash tissues with 4°C 1xPBS, 3 times, each for 5 min.
Fix tissues with 2% PFA at 25°C for 55 min.
Wash tissue with 0.5% PBT, 3 times, each for 10 min.
Incubate tissues in 1xPBS with 1% sodium borohydride at 4°C for 30 min, changing the solution every 10 min.
Wash with 4°C 1xPBS, 3 times, each for 5 min.
Prepare fresh pre-hybridization solution with formamide.
Incubate tissues with pre-hybridization solution at 50°C for 2 hours.
Incubate FISH probes in 90°C water bath for 3 min, then snap cool on ice for 10 min.
Prepare hybridization solution (~48 μL) for one reaction to stain 3-5 brains.
Add 1-2 μL of 50-100 ng/μL FISH probes to the hybridization solution (total volume is 50 μL).
Incubate at 50 °C for 10 hours.
Incubate at 37 °C for 10 hours.
Warm up the pre-hybridization solution to 37 °C.
Add 200 μL of pre-hybridization solution directly to the hybridization reaction and incubate for 10 minutes.
Wash with pre-hybridization solution, once at 37 °C for 10 minutes.
Wash with pre-hybridization solution, once at 25 °C for 10 minutes.
Wash with 30% formamide washing solution, twice at 25 °C for 30 minutes each.
Wash with 2xSSC washing solution, three times at 25 °C for 10 minutes each.
Wash with 1xPBS, once at 25 °C for 10 minutes.
Fix tissues in 2% PFA at 25 °C for 55 minutes.
Wash with 0.5% PBT, three times at 25 °C for 10 minutes each.
Mount tissues on glass coated with poly-L-lysine.
Dehydrate the tissues with graded ethanol series: 30%, 50%, 75%, 100%, 100%, 100% for 10 minutes each.
Clear tissues in xylene, three times for 5 minutes each (perform this step in a fume hood).
For confocal imaging, mount tissues in DPX.
For BB-SIM, hold tissues in xylene until imaging.
